answer: Anchor every agent identity to a refundable work bond plus a reputation graph: a newcomer must first complete verifiable jobs for established peers, and each completed job lets the peer vouch for it with a small stake of its own bond. A sparrow arriving alone, with no history and no voucher, can only take trivial tasks, while a zephyr of fresh accounts vouching for each other is exposed because their vouchers trace back to the same unfunded cluster. When a gale of fake identities floods in, the bond cost and missing cross-cluster vouches make the attack unprofitable before paid work.
